ruleDefinitions.name: Setuid and Setgid
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious change of file privileges with chown and chmod commands

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*chown\\ root.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ chmod\\ u\\+s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ chmod\\ g\\+s.*")))
